14:
Discharge assessment 
❑ Ensure patients and their caregivers understand 
that anyone with at least 3 episodes of diarrhoea
in 24 hours should seek treatment.
❑ Ensure all patients and their caregivers 
understand how to prevent cholera before 
discharge.
❑ Provide at least 4 packets of ORS for all patients 
who are discharged to use at home.  
The packets can also be used for any family members or neighbours
how begin to have diarrhoea.
❑ For paediatric patients give sufficient zinc to 
complete 10 days treatment.
